codeReview.summary: Implementation covers the requested search/filter UX: 300ms debounced search, category/date/amount filters, collapsible filter panel, clear/reset behavior, responsive layout, and filtered no-results state. Hook/query-param wiring and test coverage are strong.

issues.description: The no-results EmptyState 'Clear Filters' action calls setFilters({}) directly, which bypasses TransactionFilters' resetKey path. Because SearchInput keeps local state initialized once (frontend/src/components/TransactionFilters.tsx:78), the search text can remain visible after this clear action while results are unfiltered, creating UI/filter-state mismatch.

Debounced search applies onFiltersChange({ ...filters, search }) using the filters object captured when typing. If another filter changes before the 300ms timer fires, the delayed callback can overwrite newer filter state, causing intermittent loss of AND-combined filters.
